description: This file defines classes and templates for constructing, manipulating, and validating Ethernet, IPv4, TCP, and UDP frames within the WPEFramework Core namespace. It includes data structures for Ethernet frames, IPv4 packets, TCP segments, and UDP datagrams, with methods for setting headers, calculating checksums, and extracting source/destination addresses.

classes.name: EthernetFrameType
classes.description: Template class representing an Ethernet frame with methods to load data and access MAC addresses.

classes.name: IPv4FrameType
classes.description: Template class for IPv4 packet handling, including header initialization, source/destination address management, and checksum calculation.

classes.name: TCPv4FrameType
classes.description: Template class for TCP segments within IPv4 packets, providing source/destination port management and frame loading.

classes.name: UDPv4FrameType
classes.description: Template class for UDP datagrams within IPv4 packets, including checksum validation and port management.

methods.name: Load
methods.description: Loads raw data into the frame buffer, returning the number of bytes copied.

methods.name: Source
methods.description: Gets or sets the source address or port in the respective frame.

methods.name: Destination
methods.description: Gets or sets the destination address or port in the respective frame.

methods.name: Checksum
methods.description: Calculates the checksum for headers or pseudo-headers to ensure data integrity.
